strings.name: Wang Shu
strings.summary: Born in Ürümqi and trained in Nanjing, Wang has worked mainly in Hangzhou. He co-founded Amateur Architecture Studio with Lu Wenyu in 1997, using salvaged tiles and bricks, local craft and on-site experimentation to address demolition and memory amid rapid urbanization. Ningbo History Museum and the China Academy of Art's Xiangshan campus represent their team's work. Wang won the 2012 Pritzker Prize; his teaching and design connect architecture with everyday life, cultural traditions and material reuse.
